prompt: Create an ultra-premium street basketball sneaker advertising poster for an original brand called VANTAGE X, designed as a Cannes-level key visual that fuses luxury product photography, aggressive black-ink sports illustration, and explosive urban editorial typography. Preserve the exact core structure and camera logic of the image: one monumental hyper-real high-top basketball sneaker dominates the lower foreground in an extreme low-angle perspective, while a giant hand-drawn basketball player erupts across the upper background in a violent forward-driving action pose. The final image must now combine stronger Orbit impact, tighter Transit system control, and bolder Port-level concept integration, so the shoe feels like the source of all motion, power, and graphic force in the poster. Core composition: Use a tall vertical poster with one oversized sneaker in the lower-left to lower-center foreground, pushed slightly closer to the viewer for greater visual pressure. The toe box, side emblem, collar, laces, and outsole must feel monumental and tactile, as if the shoe is stepping directly into the viewer’s space. Behind and above it, place one huge black-ink sketch basketball player in an extreme explosive drive, jump, or pre-dunk attack moment, twisting through the frame with sharp momentum. Add one smaller secondary sketched player in the mid-background for layered court rhythm. The shoe must be the first thing seen; the illustrated players act as amplified motion ghosts generated by the shoe’s energy. Orbit impact enhancement: Increase the visual aggression of the foreground shoe. Make the sole impact at the base feel like it detonates the composition through bold black brush bursts, ink spray, fractured motion streaks, and launch-like ground energy. Tighten the distance between camera and shoe so the product feels heavier, closer, and more dominant. The poster must hit instantly with a “one step breaks the frame” sensation. Transit system enhancement: Keep the same skeletal layout, but unify the entire visual language into a mature black-and-white street-illustration system with one controlled hero product color event. The background athlete linework, speed lines, sketch shading, annotation marks, headline typography, secondary text, and impact splashes must all follow one disciplined graphic grammar: consistent ink weight, consistent roughness, consistent motion direction, and coordinated negative-space balance. The whole piece must feel like an official international sports campaign poster, not a collage of separate ideas. Port concept enhancement: Push the concept so the athlete’s motion visibly originates from the sneaker. Let selected ink lines, force strokes, and motion arcs extend from the shoe edges, outsole, and side emblem into the illustrated player’s limbs and trajectory, creating a clear idea that the player’s explosive action is being driven by the sneaker itself. The giant player can be captured in a more extreme airborne breakthrough or pre-slam moment, with the action lines visually tethered back to the shoe. The concept must feel bold and intelligent, not gimmicky. Product design: Design the shoe as a premium globally market-ready high-top street basketball sneaker from VANTAGE X. Use a bold colorway of metallic bronze-gold, matte black, off-white, and subtle silver technical accents. The upper should combine structured leather, engineered support panels, padded ankle protection, reinforced lace wings, sculpted heel geometry, and performance-driven outsole logic. Add an original VANTAGE X emblem on the lateral side. The shoe must feel elite, urban, muscular, and collectible. Material realism: Render the sneaker with exceptional realism and sharp commercial detail. The bronze-gold leather must feel smooth, rich, and premium with controlled highlights. Black areas must feel deep and performance-oriented with distinct texture separation. Show crisp stitching, lace weave, rubber density, sole grip, collar padding, and precise panel edges. The product must feel expensive, durable, and technically believable. Illustration style: Render the players and court world in expressive black ink sketch style with editorial sports aggression: raw contour lines, scratch shading, manga-like force marks, speed streaks, splatter accents, rough court geometry, and brush-impact sweeps. The drawn world should remain powerful but clearly secondary to the shoe. Keep the illustration highly art-directed, not messy. Typography and copy: Add fully original English typography integrated into the composition. Use one powerful headline such as “OWN THE ASPHALT” or “RISE ABOVE IMPACT,” rendered in a sharp custom street-sport editorial style. Add a refined support line such as “Engineered for explosive lift, locked grip, and court-born dominance.” Include a small premium VANTAGE X brand mark. Typography must feel dynamic, urban, aggressive, and compositionally precise. No copied wording, no generic font block. Background and environment: Keep the environment mostly white and minimal, constructed from perspective court lines, urban fragments, black ink slashes, motion scratches, and negative space. Use explosive black brushwork near the shoe base to anchor the product and visually launch the athlete upward. The environment must feel graphic and fast, never cluttered. Lighting: Use premium studio lighting on the sneaker, with soft directional highlights from upper-left and front-left, giving the metallic bronze-gold surfaces a luxurious glow. The illustration can remain flatter and more graphic, but should align with the shoe’s motion and shadow logic. The contrast between hyper-real product lighting and raw ink energy is essential. Color direction: Keep the overall palette tightly controlled: white field, black illustration system, bronze-gold hero product surfaces, black technical components, off-white sole accents, and minimal silver highlights. The shoe must remain the dominant color event in the frame. Mood: explosive, urban, dominant, athletic, rebellious, premium, graphic, collectible, aggressive, editorial, high-performance, street-basketball energy. Rendering style: ultra-premium sneaker campaign poster, oversized hyper-real basketball shoe, extreme low-angle perspective, giant black-ink sketch athlete, unified street illustration system, motion lines extending from shoe into athlete action, luxury material realism, dynamic editorial typography, 8k, world-class advertising image quality. Negative prompt: copied logos, copied slogans, generic shoe design, weak foreground shoe, cluttered background, soft blurry sneaker, cheap comic style, flat materials, plastic-looking bronze panels, messy typography, low-resolution sketch lines, weak motion, generic sports ad, over-rendered city background
